title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Gold -2.2% → $3,556 — selling ahead of PCE/Fed; reverses last week's rally
BTC -2.4% → ~$59,100 — 7th weekly loss in a row; Nov ETF outflows near $5B
PCE Oct + GDP Q3 print today 13:30 UTC — core PCE seen 3.2% y/y, GDP 3.5%
BlackRock: markets price 3 Dec hikes, BlackRock sees only 2 — hawkish odds may fade
FinCEN discloses cybersecurity incident 25 Nov
